from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class GreeFinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """One reported value of non-current asset disposal gains/losses from one quarterly financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name, e.g. '珠海格力电器股份有限公司'")
    fiscal_year: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal year of the report, e.g. 2020")
    quarter: str | None = Field(description="The quarter of the report, e.g. 'Q1' or '第一季度'")
    line_item_description: str | None = Field(description="The line item description as written in the report")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount; negative values indicate losses")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g. '元' or '人民币元'")
    source_document_summary: str | None = Field(description="Brief identifier for which document this came from")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    gree_non_current_asset_disposal_results: list[GreeFinancialItem]
